They needed a small check and a program built for them, at a time when the best-known accelerators were designed for consumer apps. So he carved out a home for that group: Alchemist, an accelerator built only for enterprise founders and backed by DFJ, Khosla Ventures, US Venture Partners, Cisco and SAP. Alchemist strength in community Danielle D'Agostaro joined as co-founder in 2013.
